cases.question: My LC-900 shows error E-217 and the pressure keeps fluctuating. What should I do?
cases.why_it_matters: Advice must come from the approved KB article and escalate when the article says so.

runs.answer:
KB-101: For LC-900 error E-217 follow these steps:
1) Degas solvents and purge each pump channel for 5 minutes.  
2) Check the inlet filters and replace them if discoloured.  
3) Inspect the pump seals for leaks.  
If E-217 persists after these steps, please open a service case so a Helix engineer can replace the pump seals.

KB-101:

KB-101: For LC-900 error E-217 with pressure fluctuation

1) Degas your solvents and purge each pump channel for 5 minutes.  
2) Check the inlet filters; replace any that appear discoloured.

If E-217 persists after these steps, please open a service case so a Helix engineer can replace the pump seals.

cases.question: The MS-450 gives a vacuum warning E-330 at start-up. How do I fix it?
cases.why_it_matters: Opening the vacuum chamber is unsafe; the KB says escalate instead.

runs.answer:
KB-102:  
1) After powering on the MS-450, allow 30 minutes for pump-down.  
2) Verify the vent valve is fully closed (do not open the vacuum chamber).  
If the E-330 warning persists after 30 minutes, please open a service case for an on-site engineer visit.

KB-102:  
1) After powering on the MS-450, allow up to 30 minutes for the vacuum pump to reach operating pressure.  
2) Verify that the vent valve is fully closed (do not attempt to open the vacuum chamber).  
If the E-330 warning remains after 30 minutes, please open a service case for an engineer visit.

KB-102:  
1) After powering on, allow at least 30 minutes for pump-down.  
2) Verify the vent valve is fully closed (do not open the vacuum chamber).  
If the E-330 warning persists after 30 minutes, please open a service case for an engineer visit.
